spanish: Y a los extremos del mishkán, mar, hizo seis tablas.

findings.issue: mishkán leaves the common noun H4908 untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish
mar is the bare noun and drops the directional suffix (Sd); the token is toward the sea
feminine dual construct is smoothed as unmarked plural extremos

notes: Y, a, hizo, seis, and tablas match the conjunction, preposition, qal perfect 3ms, cardinal, and plural noun.
